summary.text: On Dominaria, Teferi, Saheeli and Kaya build a Temporal Anchor so that Teferi can cross time and learn how to activate the sylex, and Jodah discovers that the tower was built by Urza, Teferi's teacher and his own ancestor.

The time travel carries the story back to the wars of Urza and Mishra, where Kroog falls to Mishra's dragon engines, Fallaji and Argivian soldiers fight in the trenches, and Kayla and Tawnos try to keep Penregon alive as the world freezes and Talite crusaders turn on its machines.

Meanwhile the Phyrexians press their war, compleating Ajani, carrying the sylex-guarding Karn away to Elesh Norn, and attacking the Coalition's stronghold, where Elspeth and Jodah are left facing a blinding pillar of light.
